title: Redesign product website around the real TermAl control room
outcome: Replace the current light editorial marketing site with a responsive, accessible product website that visually matches TermAl's pane-based local control room and accurately presents current capabilities: multi-agent sessions, delegations/mailboxes, visual orchestrators, response board, remote hosts, approvals, diffs, durable state, and themes. Preserve the dependency-free static deployment and verifier contracts.
acceptance: The website visually reflects the current TermAl UI rather than a generic editorial landing page; copy covers current product capabilities without overclaiming; desktop and mobile layouts are coherent; interactive demo and progressive enhancement/reduced-motion/accessibility contracts remain valid; node website/verify.mjs passes.
